fusions.name: Spread-Finger Sweep
fusions.desc: Drags your spread fingers across a cone ahead of you, dealing 11 damage and making each enemy [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gleaning Swipe
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up. Swipes the target for 7 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 0.8 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Raked Into a Heap
fusions.desc: Hooks your long arms around a point ahead of you for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it into a heap. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathers the Stragglers
fusions.desc: Against wounded enemies low on health, your damage rises by 12%.
